metadata.description: Machine-readable tracking of model integration opportunities

integrations.name: Ensemble + BNN Multioutput Uncertainty
integrations.description: Add uncertainty quantification (90% confidence intervals) to ensemble predictions using BNN Multioutput v1
integrations.expected_benefit: Provide uncertainty bands for risk-aware betting decisions. Enable users to see prediction confidence ranges.
test_plan: Generate BNN confidence intervals for 2025 season games
Compare ensemble point predictions with BNN intervals
Verify 90% CI coverage on historical data (2024 season)
Integrate into dashboard as uncertainty bands
A/B test betting performance with vs without uncertainty-aware bet sizing

success_criteria.calibration: 90% CI coverage achieved on validation set
success_criteria.betting: Reduced variance in betting outcomes (lower drawdown)

new_features: Confidence interval bands on prediction charts

integrations.hardware: M4 Mac (inference only, BNN already trained)

integrations.name: Ensemble + BNN Environment Features
integrations.description: Extract learned environmental features from Environment BNN to augment ensemble despite poor standalone calibration
integrations.expected_benefit: Leverage Environment BNN's learned representations even though standalone calibration failed (29.7% CI coverage). May capture weather/dome/rest interactions not explicit in baseline features.
test_plan: Extract hidden layer activations from Environment BNN
Add as features to ensemble XGBoost component
Retrain ensemble with environmental embeddings
Compare test accuracy and calibration vs baseline
Perform ablation: embeddings alone vs embeddings + explicit features

success_criteria.feature_importance: Environmental embeddings appear in top 15 features
success_criteria.academic: Documented as repurposing failed model in dissertation

new_features: Game context similarity scores (e.g., 'Similar to KC@BUF in extreme cold')

integrations.hardware: M4 Mac (feature extraction), 4090 optional (if retraining BNN)

integrations.name: Ensemble + RL Policy
integrations.description: Use RL agents (CQL/IQL/DQN/PPO) to optimize betting strategy given ensemble predictions
integrations.expected_benefit: Optimize bet sizing and game selection dynamically using RL. Current Kelly criterion is static; RL can learn temporal patterns (e.g., bet more conservatively early season, exploit late season).
test_plan: Audit RL agent code status (nfl_analytics/rl/)
Retrain agents on 2019-2024 betting outcomes
Backtest RL policy vs static Kelly on 2024 season
Compare Sharpe ratio, max drawdown, total ROI
Deploy best RL policy for 2025 season

success_criteria.roi: Annual ROI improvement >= 2% over static Kelly (10-15% → 12-17%)
success_criteria.academic: Complete Chapter 5 (RL Design) and integrate into Chapter 11 (Profit Optimization)

dependencies: Fresh RL training on updated data

integrations.name: BNN Variants Stacking
integrations.description: Stack multiple BNN variants (Multioutput, Mixture, Simpler, Deeper) to create meta-BNN with improved calibration
integrations.expected_benefit: Ensemble BNN predictions to reduce variance and improve calibration. Different BNN architectures may capture complementary uncertainty sources.
test_plan: Evaluate BNN Mixture v2 and Simpler v2 (currently untested)
Generate predictions from all BNN variants on 2024 validation set
Train meta-model to combine BNN predictions (logistic regression or simple average)
Measure stacked 90% CI coverage vs individual BNNs
Compare calibration error vs best individual BNN

success_criteria.improvement: Calibration error reduction >= 10% vs best individual BNN
success_criteria.academic: Documented in Chapter 6 as BNN ensemble method

integrations.hardware: M4 Mac (evaluation and stacking), 4090 if retraining needed
blocking_issues: BNN Mixture v2 not yet evaluated (1.3 GB trained model exists)
BNN Simpler v2 not yet evaluated (10 MB trained model exists)

integrations.name: Ensemble + GNN Embeddings
integrations.description: Use GNN node/graph embeddings as features for ensemble XGBoost component
integrations.expected_benefit: Capture relational information (schedule networks, team similarity) via GNN embeddings. GNN standalone accuracy is poor (46-50%) but embeddings may complement ensemble.
test_plan: Extract GNN embeddings for all teams and games
Add embeddings as features to ensemble XGBoost
Retrain ensemble with GNN features
Compare test accuracy vs baseline
Analyze feature importance: do GNN embeddings rank high?

success_criteria.academic: Documented in Chapter 4 (GNN as feature source, not standalone)

integrations.hardware: 4090 Desktop (GNN embedding extraction may be GPU-intensive)

integrations.name: Ensemble + cVAE Trajectory Simulation
integrations.description: Use cVAE to simulate game trajectories for rare/extreme scenarios, feed results to ensemble for what-if analysis
integrations.expected_benefit: Generate synthetic game trajectories for rare events (e.g., extreme weather, massive underdog win) to test ensemble robustness. Not directly predictive, but valuable for sensitivity analysis.
test_plan: Define cVAE use case: uncertainty quantification, rare event simulation, or counterfactuals
Generate synthetic games for 2-3 extreme scenarios
Evaluate ensemble predictions on synthetic data
Compare ensemble behavior on synthetic vs real data
Document limitations and use cases

success_criteria.use_case: Clearly defined experimental purpose for cVAE
success_criteria.synthetic_quality: Generated trajectories pass realism checks (stat distributions)
success_criteria.ensemble_robustness: Ensemble predictions stable on synthetic data
success_criteria.academic: Documented in Chapter 7 (Simulation) with concrete experiments

dependencies: Define cVAE concrete use case (currently undefined)
blocking_issues: cVAE use case undefined (trained but no experiments designed)

integrations.name: Ensemble + Causal Inference
integrations.description: Apply causal framework (SCM, diff-in-diff, synthetic control) to identify causal effects of interventions (e.g., coaching changes, rule changes) on game outcomes
integrations.expected_benefit: Answer causal questions (e.g., 'Does firing a coach mid-season improve team performance?') to inform betting strategy. Complements predictive ensemble with explanatory power.
test_plan: Identify 2-3 causal questions (e.g., coaching changes, rest days, prime time games)
Apply causal framework to historical data
Estimate treatment effects with confidence intervals
Integrate causal findings into ensemble feature engineering
Document methodology and results

success_criteria.feature_engineering: Causal insights inform new ensemble features

dependencies: Define specific causal questions to investigate

new_features: Causal factor explanations (e.g., 'Coach firing effect: +3% win prob')

blocking_issues: Causal framework complete but not yet applied to data
Need to define specific causal questions

integrations.name: BNN + RL Uncertainty-Aware Policy
integrations.description: Train RL agent with BNN uncertainty as state input to learn risk-aware betting policy (bet more when uncertain, exploit when confident)
integrations.expected_benefit: Combine BNN uncertainty quantification with RL betting optimization. Agent learns to size bets based on prediction confidence, reducing risk during high-uncertainty periods.
test_plan: Generate BNN predictions with CI for historical data
Augment RL state space with BNN uncertainty metrics
Retrain RL agents with uncertainty-aware state
Backtest policy vs static Kelly and uncertainty-agnostic RL
Compare Sharpe ratio and max drawdown

success_criteria.sharpe: Sharpe ratio improvement >= 0.3 over static Kelly

blocking_issues: Depends on INT-001 and INT-003 completion

integrations.name: Multi-Model Ensemble (ALL SPOKES)
integrations.description: Ultimate integration: combine Ensemble, BNN, GNN, RL, Causal into unified meta-ensemble with specialized components for prediction, uncertainty, strategy
integrations.expected_benefit: Comprehensive system integrating all research vectors. Ensemble for point predictions, BNN for uncertainty, GNN for relational features, RL for betting strategy, Causal for explanation. Maximum capability at cost of complexity.
test_plan: Complete INT-001 through INT-007 first
Design architecture: hub-and-spokes with clear interfaces
Implement meta-model combining all components
Extensive backtesting on 2019-2024 data
Production deployment with monitoring

success_criteria.academic: Complete dissertation with all chapters using integrated system

new_features: Unified prediction dashboard with all model components
Switchable model views (point prediction, uncertainty, strategy, explanation)

blocking_issues: Requires completion of INT-001 through INT-007
